newsitem.title: UK: Sema to merge with Financiere Sema.
newsitem.headline: Sema to merge with Financiere Sema.

text.p: Anglo-French electronics and computer services company Sema Group Plc said on Monday it was merging with Financiere Sema, the largest shareholder in Sema.

As part of its plans to expand in the U.S., Sema said that the two main shareholders in Financiere Sema -- the Paribas Group and France Telecom - would take a stake of 20.62 and 20.55 percent respectively in Sema.

The shareholding structure of Financiere Sema's has constrained Sema's activities in the U.S. because under U.S. banking law Sema Group is deemed to be a subsidiary of a banking institution, restricting Sema from undertaking non-financial activities in the U.S.
Sema also announced it plans to buy the remaining interests in the outsourcing joint ventures with Sema Group in the UK and France from France Telecom.
It will buy the 24.5 percent interest in Sema Group Outsourcing Plc from France Telecom and the 60 percent stake in TS FM Holding it does not already own.
Sema will pay France Telecom 42 million stg in shares, of which 11.6 million is for the outstanding payment on Sema's initial 40 percent stake in TS FM.

"The reorganisation of our shareholder structure is a very positive development for the Sema Group, allowing us both much greater access to the vast business potential of the USA and the opportunity to offer our services as a single global provider of IT services to multinationals," said Sema chief executive Pierre Bonnelli.
By 1239 GMT, shares in Sema had climbed 57-1/2p to stand at 1,345p.
